changelog:
- Initial release of Agent Browser skill.
- Provides a fast Rust-based headless browser automation CLI with Node.js fallback.
- Enables web navigation, interaction, form filling, data extraction, and UI testing via structured bash commands.
- Supports interactive element referencing, semantic locators, screenshots, PDFs, video recording, cookies, storage, and network control.
- Includes comprehensive command descriptions for automating common browser actions.
